title: SentinelX Action Contract
description: Standard response action contract for notifications and remediation actions (M6/M7, X10)

action_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifier of the action

action_type.description: Classification of the remediation or notification action

incident_id.description: UUID of the correlated incident triggering this action

target.description: Target entity for the action (e.g. IP address, hostname, URL, or username)

parameters.description: Arbitrary key-value configuration parameters passed to the action handler

status.description: Execution lifecycle state of the action

requested_by.description: Identifier of the actor or system triggering the action

requested_at.description: UTC timestamp when the action was requested

executed_at.description: UTC timestamp when action execution completed or terminated

result.description: Execution output, return payload, or failure details
